content.comment_body: Hello, I have a page in [product_name] Web Editor published on AWS, and I'd like to know if it’s possible to support additional users or enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) or two-factor authentication (2FA). Using only a single password seems risky for security. Thank you!

Unfortunately, [product_name] Web Editor does not provide true multi-user support. You can have a 'guest' user, but this user is limited to read-only access. MFA/2FA features are also not available for this system.

analysis.insight_summary: A user voiced concerns about the security of a web-based interface hosted externally, requesting multi-user management and multi-factor authentication. The current solution only provides a single main user and an optional read-only guest account, lacking more advanced user roles and MFA/2FA, leading to potential vulnerabilities for shared access environments.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects functionalities for managing several users with different permissions and enabling multi-factor authentication to ensure higher security.
